Suspicion step: WHERE gen_joiningstatus = 7 AND gen_sendtobankdate IS NOT NULL AND datediff(day, ?, gen_sendtobankdate) <= 0 with ? = User::LastThreeWorkingDays ({81CBF82A...}, DTSX:42); derived 12; script DTSX:5935-5939 sets only gen_joiningstatus. Hypotheses and unproven meanings are labelled. scopeNote: only SDK writers for business (DTSX:1376, 5939); every [CRM] use (two OLE DB sources, two Lookups, Get SystemConfigurations, Execute SQL Get NonWorkingDays) is a SELECT; Configuration type 1 file C:\Generix\SSISConfigFile.dtsConfig; ServerName/OrganizationName set by Set Variables from gen_etlvariable rows (DTSX:4106-4110, PostExecute loop).

Constraint lines verified: 6508 Get Variables -> Create ETL; 6506 Create ETL -> Close Joining processes; 6510 Close -> Get NonWorkingDays; 6509 Get NonWorkingDays -> Update LastThreeWorkingDays; 6511 -> Update SuspicionAsEmitted; 6507 -> End ETL. No DTS:Value/Expression attributes (all Success, LogicalAnd); nothing disabled. Event handlers OnError (Error ETL Process record) and OnPostExecute (Cancel ETL Process record, whose body is fully commented out, DTSX:7224-7246) are ETL framing and not listed - not business logic.

Traced ScriptMain (DTSX:5237-5264): counter starts at 1, currDate = DateTime.Now.AddDays(-1).Date; a day with no matching row increments the counter or breaks at 3; the date is decremented only when not breaking. No rules: D-1 (1->2), D-2 (2->3), D-3 break -> D-3. Loop i<21 checks D-1..D-21; without break currDate ends at D-22. Match is dt.Select("starttime = '" + currDate.ToString() + "'") - exact equality to local midnight via a culture-dependent string. Get NonWorkingDays SQL (DTSX:4090): starttime between GetutcDate()-21 and GetutcDate() AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(Name,''))) in ('Friday','Saturday','Holiday'). Meanings labelled as names/hypothesis.
